crops_opened_note: F2, F7, F8 and F12 are tier-B whole-figure crops: the crop is the figure image, opened as the figure. The other ten are separate crop files under panels/crops/. F4a, F6c, F11a and F11b were opened as part of their whole figures but are not cited.
figures_cited_without_panel_ids_note: F3 (C6_unresolved), F5 (C4_two_level) and F9 (C3_caption_swap) offer no panels; each is cited with figs only and panel_ids [], read as a whole figure.

technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.note: No conflicts. Cue 'micrograph' on F1a, F1b, F4d, F6a, F6b and F6d all carry attrs.technique SEM, which is in the micrograph family list. F4b, F4c, F10a and F10b are recorded with cue classes [] and are therefore not checked; MECH:tensile (F4b), SEM (F4c) and SIM:FEM / MECH:tensile (F10a, F10b) were chosen from the panel content. F2, F7, F8 and F12 have no OCR at all. F3, F5 and F9 offer no panels.

F4c is recorded with cue classes [] and 'scale bar: False' although the crop plainly shows a 10 um bar and is an SEM micrograph of the same series as F4d. The SEM technique was kept and the citation retained, since an empty cue list is not a conflict.
